note: Read by tools/restructure/move.mjs. `homes`: the folder of a feature when it is not named like the feature (structure-conventions, section 2: `ai-local.js` goes to `server/ai/`; `server/lighting/`, `server/phone/` and `server/capture/` cannot be made: the first two would stand beside `lighting.js` and `phone.js`, the third is ignored by git). `places`: the folder of one file, for the two features whose files are shared and sit in several small folders. `makes`: folders a move may make, each named like its feature. `features` and `files`: loose files of `server/` that stay where they are on purpose, each with the reason the report prints. `shims`: old paths that keep their one line after `move.mjs unshim`, because something outside this repo loads them by that path.

files.server/remote-access.js: the gate lists of paired devices and the order of their checks: the security notes and every review point at this path
files.server/feature-routes.js: the one list of routes beside server.js: the rules of the repo name it by this path as the place a new route is listed
files.server/atomic-write.js: shared by every store, and the rules of the repo name it by this path (structure-conventions, section 5: shared infrastructure keeps its paths)
files.server/linux-collectors.js: shared by many features (structure-conventions, section 5: collectors keep their paths)
files.server/darwin-collectors.js: shared by many features (structure-conventions, section 5: collectors keep their paths)
